verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents program-level transaction or volume limits, account approval or underwriting stages, or a published path to raising limits. The mentions of 'flexible limits' on corporate cards and payment approval flows in Web Banking are adjacent features: they cover customer-side spending controls and internal approval workflows, not bank-imposed program limits. Self-serve sandbox signup and a production switch requiring only new credentials are also adjacent and do not show documented limit or approval tiers.
